product_metadata.title: Clotheslnewire 5/32x100'
features: Extruped P V C Wire Cable Clothesline
Non Staining and gentle on clothes
description: Wellington's Wire Cable Core Clothesline is their premium grade PVC clothesline. Constructed with a super strong twisted wire cable center core, this line gives very little stretch. It is a good choice in high humidity areas and is recommended for use with wire rope clamps. This 5/32-inch green clothesline comes in a length of 100 feet. Wellington is dedicated to producing the highest quality products in the industry.
